definitions.gloss: illustration, picture inserted in a text
definitions.explanation: An illustration or picture inserted within the pages of a book, magazine, or other printed text to complement or decorate the writing.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{挿絵|さしえ}が{入|はい}った{絵本|えほん}だ。
examples.english: It's a picture book with beautiful illustrations.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}の{挿絵|さしえ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{画家|がか}が{描|えが}いた。
examples.english: The illustrations for this novel were drawn by a famous artist.

examples.japanese: {挿絵|さしえ}があると、{物語|ものがたり}の{場面|ばめん}がより{鮮|あざ}やかにイメージできる。
examples.english: With illustrations, one can visualize the scenes of the story more vividly.

notes:
USAGE:
{挿絵|さしえ} specifically refers to illustrations within a text — not standalone artwork. It is distinct from {絵|え} (picture in general) and イラスト (illustration in the modern/commercial sense). {挿絵|さしえ} has a somewhat literary or traditional feel and is commonly used for book illustrations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挿絵|さしえ}を{描|えが}く: to draw illustrations
- {挿絵|さしえ}{入|い}り: illustrated (with illustrations)
- {挿絵|さしえ}{画家|がか}: illustrator (for books)
